voiceSummary: Regency Ceramics Limited published un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Telugu Prabha. Novelix Pharmaceuticals Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, showing a net profit of 156.32 lakhs for the quarter. Sheshadri Industries Limited released unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, recording a net profit of 64.12 lakhs for the quarter. UGRO Capital Limited issued a possession notice for immovable property belonging to borrowers Mahalaxmi Traders, Priyanka Ananthu, and Satyanaraya Ananthu, with possession taken on November 7, 2026. Country Club Hospitality & Holidays Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and year ended September 30, 2026. Aananda Lakshmi Spinning Mills Limited filed unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Regency Ceramics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Regency Ceramics Limited reported a net loss of Rs. 334.21 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these unaudited financial results on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 2,326.47 lakhs for the quarter. The company recorded an accumulated loss of Rs. 13,499.87 lakhs as of September 30, 2026, resulting in net worth erosion. The financial statements were prepared on a going concern basis. The company has refurbished a manufacturing line in Yanam and operates a facility in Andhra Pradesh. An arbitral award of Rs. 133.30 crores plus interest was pronounced in March 2022 in favor of the company regarding insurance claims. The insurance company has appealed this award. The results are subject to a limited review by auditors.
